facts.fact_content: Ericsson surpassed the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 2 cents in the last reported quarter.
The Zacks Consensus Estimate for total revenues for the December quarter is $6.96 billion.
The Zacks Consensus Estimate for total revenues indicates growth from the year-ago quarter’s reported figure of $6.76 billion.
The consensus estimate for adjusted earnings per share for the December quarter is 21 cents.
The consensus estimate for adjusted earnings per share suggests growth from 16 cents reported in the prior-year quarter.
The estimate for revenues from the Networks segment is SEK 45.19 billion.
The estimate for revenues from the Networks segment implies marginal growth of 0.4% year over year.
The revenue estimate for the Cloud Software and Services segment is SEK 18.04 billion.
The revenue estimate for the Cloud Software and Services segment suggests a 7.7% decrease year over year.
The estimate for revenues from the Enterprise business is SEK 7.4 billion.
The estimate for revenues from the Enterprise business implies a 10.6% year-over-year improvement.
